post.description: Generates speech for 1 to 500 characters in one call and returns the audio URL with the credits charged. Answers 202 with { jobId, status, resultUrl } if the job is still processing after 220 s; read the result at resultUrl, or send the same request again — it is not charged twice. The same input and options within 24 hours return the same job; an Idempotency-Key, when sent, is the key instead.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Repeat the same key within 24 hours to retry safely: the first result comes back and nothing is made twice. A new request needs a new key.

202.description: The job is still processing after 220 s and keeps running. Read the result at resultUrl, or send the same request again.

post.description: Starts a Speech to Text job for an uploaded audio file of up to 10 minutes and 200 MB, and returns its jobId. Get the transcription from GET /v1/speech-to-text/jobs/{jobId} or the job.completed webhook.

file.description: Audio file (mp3, wav, flac, m4a, aac, webm, ogg, opus, amr). Up to 10 minutes, 200 MB.

language.description: auto (default) detects Arabic or English; ar for Arabic and mixed Arabic/English; en only for wholly English speech.

numbers_as_digits.description: Write spoken numbers as digits (صفر واحد واحد → 011). Set false to keep them as words. Applies to Arabic; English transcripts are never converted.

identify_speakers.description: Identify who speaks when: the finished job then lists the speakers and the transcript split into timed segments, each tagged with its speaker. Leave it out or send false for the transcript text alone.

terminology.description: Your own terms, as a JSON string: names, products and acronyms the transcript should spell your way. The finished job then carries terminology, with the transcript corrected to them; transcription stays as heard. Shape: {"keywords": [...]}, each keyword a term string or {term, variants, blocked, context_words, needs_context}. Up to 500 keywords and 256 KB; each term and variant up to 100 characters, 10 variants and 20 blocked phrases or context words per keyword. Terms are written exactly as typed. Nothing is stored between requests: send the full list each time.

post.description: Transcribes an uploaded audio file of up to 10 minutes and 200 MB in one call and returns the transcription with the credits charged. Answers 202 with { jobId, status, resultUrl } if the job is still processing after 220 s; read the result at resultUrl, or send the same request again — it is not charged twice. The same input and options within 24 hours return the same job; an Idempotency-Key, when sent, is the key instead.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Repeat the same key within 24 hours to retry safely: the first result comes back and nothing is made twice. A new request needs a new key.

file.description: Audio file (mp3, wav, flac, m4a, aac, webm, ogg, opus, amr). Up to 10 minutes, 200 MB.

language.description: auto (default) detects Arabic or English; ar for Arabic and mixed Arabic/English; en only for wholly English speech.

numbers_as_digits.description: Write spoken numbers as digits (صفر واحد واحد → 011). Set false to keep them as words. Applies to Arabic; English transcripts are never converted.

identify_speakers.description: Identify who speaks when: the finished job then lists the speakers and the transcript split into timed segments, each tagged with its speaker. Leave it out or send false for the transcript text alone.

terminology.description: Your own terms, as a JSON string: names, products and acronyms the transcript should spell your way. The finished job then carries terminology, with the transcript corrected to them; transcription stays as heard. Shape: {"keywords": [...]}, each keyword a term string or {term, variants, blocked, context_words, needs_context}. Up to 500 keywords and 256 KB; each term and variant up to 100 characters, 10 variants and 20 blocked phrases or context words per keyword. Terms are written exactly as typed. Nothing is stored between requests: send the full list each time.

202.description: The job is still processing after 220 s and keeps running. Read the result at resultUrl, or send the same request again.

get.description: Returns the transcript of a completed API job of this key's workspace as a file: txt is the transcription text, srt is subtitles of at most 7 seconds and two 42-character lines per cue, each prefixed with its speaker label when speakers were identified, and json carries the text, speakers and timed segments. lang sets the language of the speaker labels. Exports use the corrected text when the job used terminology terms, and the download name comes from the uploaded file name. Needs Speech to Text access on the key.

parameters.description: The jobId the API returned when the job was created.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: txt: the transcript text. srt: subtitles, one cue per few seconds, each tagged with its speaker when known. json: text, speakers and timed segments.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the speaker labels: en gives "Speaker 1", ar gives "المتحدث 1".

200.description: The file, with Content-Disposition: attachment and its name; the body is not wrapped in { data, ... }.

text/plain.example: السلام عليكم، كيف حالك؟ بخير، الحمد لله.

application/x-subrip.example:
1
00:00:00,380 --> 00:00:04,120
[Speaker 1] السلام عليكم، كيف حالك؟

2
00:00:04,300 --> 00:00:06,400
[Speaker 2] بخير، الحمد لله.

post.description: Cleans an uploaded MP3, WAV, FLAC or OGG/Opus file of up to 10 minutes and 200 MB in one call and returns the job with the cleaned file URL. Every tuning field is optional; an omitted one uses its default. Answers 202 with { jobId, status, resultUrl } if the job is still processing after 220 s; read the result at resultUrl, or send the same request again — it is not charged twice. The same input and options within 24 hours return the same job; an Idempotency-Key, when sent, is the key instead.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Repeat the same key within 24 hours to retry safely: the first result comes back and nothing is made twice. A new request needs a new key.

file.description: Audio file (mp3, wav, flac, ogg/opus). Up to 10 minutes, 200 MB.

sampleRate.description: Sample rate of the cleaned WAV, in Hz.

bitDepth.description: Bits per sample of the cleaned WAV.

202.description: The job is still processing after 220 s and keeps running. Read the result at resultUrl, or send the same request again.

post.description: Starts a voice or chat session, as the portal's Test button does, and returns a room token and address. The token is sent only in this response: join the room with it from your client, and end the session with POST /v1/agents/{agentId}/sessions/{sessionId}/end. Uses workspace credits, which do not count against this key's credit limit, and the agent's own chat and call limits apply. A retried start opens a second session. Billing starts when the session starts, not when a client joins. End sessions you do not use. At most 10 calls a minute per key. Needs the agents:talk scope on the key.

post.description: Creates a tool that calls one public https URL with the parameters you describe. Secret header values and auth connections are referenced by id; plain values that look like credentials are refused. The request takes the call under webhook.target.url; the response shows it as webhook.url. Send an Idempotency-Key to retry safely. At most 20 calls a minute per key. Secrets are referenced by id from GET /v1/secrets; their values can only be entered in the portal vault. Free. Needs the tools:write scope on the key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Repeat the same key within 24 hours to retry safely: the first result comes back and nothing is made twice. A new request needs a new key.

post.description: Imports an OpenAPI document, inline or from a public url, as one tool with an operation for each endpoint. info.description: Arabic-first speech AI: Text to Speech, Speech to Text and Sound Cleaning, read access to your agents, plus tickets for the website widget. Every response uses the envelope { data, statusCode, success, errorMessage }.

tags.name: Developer API - V1 Text to Speech
tags.description: Turn text into speech in one call, or as a job you poll or get a webhook for.

tags.name: Developer API - V1 Speech to Text
tags.description: Transcribe audio files in one call, or as a job you poll or get a webhook for.

tags.name: Developer API - V1 Sound Cleaning
tags.description: Remove noise and level the loudness of audio files in one call.

tags.name: Developer API - V1 Agents
tags.description: Read your agents, their conversations, knowledge, tools and test runs. Needs a key with the agents:read scope.

tags.name: Developer API - V1 Agent Sessions
tags.description: Start a live voice or chat session with an agent, get its room token, read its status and end it. Needs a key with the agents:talk scope.

tags.name: Developer API - V1 Tools
tags.description: Create webhook and OpenAPI tools that use your saved secrets by id, and list tools, secrets and auth connections. Needs a key with the tools:write scope.

tags.name: Developer API - V1 Website Widget
tags.description: Mint single-use tickets that let your signed-in visitors start a private website widget.
